description: This PHP class 'ClaimController' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Claim\Controller' extends an abstract controller and manages the claim-related views, specifically setting up a Vue component named 'claim-event' during the pre-render phase. It belongs to the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically related to the Claims plugin.

classes.name: ClaimController
classes.description: Controller class for handling claim-related views and operations within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It sets up a Vue component during the pre-render process.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that initializes a Vue component named 'claim-event' and assigns it to the controller, preparing the view for rendering.
